name: Crunches
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent.
Place your hands lightly on either side of your head, keeping your elbows in — don't lock your fingers behind your head.
While pushing the small of your back down into the floor to better isolate your abdominal muscles, begin to roll your shoulders off the floor.
Contract your abdominals hard at the top and hold for a second, then lower slowly back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
